name: pilot
comment: Every choice in this file was made before any retrieval result was looked at.
The k-sizes and the alphabets are a fixed list, not a search: the two cysteine-aware
alphabets are the ones kmerseek already has, hp_pbotc_1st_ed2 is kmerseek's usual
default, dayhoff6 is the one richer alphabet this pilot tries, and protein20 is no
reduction at all. The review budget of 10 is what a person reads before giving up.
No sketch subsampling anywhere: every k-mer of every peptide is kept, which is what
scaled=1 means in kmerseek, because a 25-residue peptide sketched at any other scale
keeps one or two k-mers and the comparison becomes chance.
